nodes.description: Prepare for immediate delivery during maternal arrest; the 2026 checklist calls for cesarean delivery to be started within 4 minutes when circulation has not returned. Uterine evacuation can improve maternal hemodynamics as well as fetal outcome. Perform it where the patient is located if transfer would delay treatment. Operative vaginal delivery is an option only when complete dilation and a crowning head allow prompt birth. Apply the pregnancy cardiac-arrest protocol and individual clinical circumstances; the older 2016 guideline used a fetal viability threshold of 23 weeks.
